CorrectionBody.description:
JSON body of ``POST /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/corrections``: a ``CorrectionRequest``
without ``invoice_id``, which is the path. ``expected_version`` is the version the
reviewer saw; any other current version is refused as ``stale_version``.
CorrectionBody.title: CorrectionBody

CritiqueIssue.description: A problem with a recommendation, found by the critique model or the deterministic checks.
CritiqueIssue.title: CritiqueIssue

FieldChange.description: One corrected field: its new value and where the source shows it.
FieldChange.title: FieldChange

GateOutcome.description: Result of the deterministic policy gate (P1-04).
GateOutcome.title: GateOutcome

InvoiceStatus.description: Current business state of one invoice identity. A duplicate run never changes it.
InvoiceStatus.title: InvoiceStatus

QueueGroup.description: The review queue's sections, in display order.
QueueGroup.title: QueueGroup

Recommendation.description: What a reasoning step proposes. Never authorizes payment by itself.
Recommendation.title: Recommendation

RetryRequest.description:
Optional JSON body of ``POST /api/runs/{run_id}/retry``.

``retry`` reprocesses in the failed run's own mode, linked by ``retry_of``.
``run_offline`` runs the same document offline as a separate, labeled simulation
(``mode_switch_of``); only for live model failures, where the offline path can help.
RetryRequest.title: RetryRequest

ReviewAction.description: A human action on an invoice version (Phase 4).
ReviewAction.title: ReviewAction

ReviewDecisionBody.description:
JSON body of ``POST /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/approve`` and ``/decline``. The action
applies to ``expected_version`` only.
ReviewDecisionBody.title: ReviewDecisionBody

ReviewRefusal.description: Why a review action was refused. Stable identifiers for the UI and API.
ReviewRefusal.title: ReviewRefusal

post.description: Approve mock payment of `expected_version` (``review.approve``). The human-review run revalidates and pays only if the gate approves.

200.description: No new run: a repeated approve of the paid version answers with the paying run (`idempotent_replay`: true).

409.description: `stale_version`, `action_not_allowed`, `already_paid` or `provider_unavailable`. Review refusals carry `details.current` (AllowedActions) and `details.invoice` (the current invoice detail).

422.description: A review refusal code (e.g. `correction_not_in_source`) with `details.current`, `validation_error`, or `idempotency_key_reused`.

post.description:
Submit a corrected invoice from the vendor (``review.submit_corrected_invoice``): the
file is processed as a new version that supersedes the earlier ones. The upload is checked
like ``POST /api/runs``. ``expected_version`` is the version the reviewer saw. A file with
another vendor or invoice number fails its run with ``corrected_identity_mismatch``.

200.description: No new run: a repeated approve of the paid version answers with the paying run (`idempotent_replay`: true).

409.description: `stale_version`, `action_not_allowed`, `already_paid` or `provider_unavailable`. Review refusals carry `details.current` (AllowedActions) and `details.invoice` (the current invoice detail).

422.description: A review refusal code (e.g. `correction_not_in_source`) with `details.current`, `validation_error`, or `idempotency_key_reused`.

post.description:
Correct extracted fields with source evidence (``review.submit_correction``): a new
version is recorded and revalidated by a new run, whose id is returned at once.

200.description: No new run: a repeated approve of the paid version answers with the paying run (`idempotent_replay`: true).

409.description: `stale_version`, `action_not_allowed`, `already_paid` or `provider_unavailable`. Review refusals carry `details.current` (AllowedActions) and `details.invoice` (the current invoice detail).

422.description: A review refusal code (e.g. `correction_not_in_source`) with `details.current`, `validation_error`, or `idempotency_key_reused`.

post.description: Decline `expected_version` (``review.decline``): the human-review run rejects it at the gate; no payment.

200.description: No new run: a repeated approve of the paid version answers with the paying run (`idempotent_replay`: true).

409.description: `stale_version`, `action_not_allowed`, `already_paid` or `provider_unavailable`. Review refusals carry `details.current` (AllowedActions) and `details.invoice` (the current invoice detail).

422.description: A review refusal code (e.g. `correction_not_in_source`) with `details.current`, `validation_error`, or `idempotency_key_reused`.

get.description:
Invoices waiting on a person, in three groups (``review.list_queue``); each item
carries its AllowedActions.

post.description:
Explicitly retry a recoverable failed run (P3-08). Creates a new linked run; never
resumes the failed one. Refusals use the RetryRefused reason as the error code.
